d: A stock surges 5,000%, its founder becomes a billionaire and investors rush to buy in. But a Bloomberg investigation alleges that the spectacular rally was fuelled by manufactured trading activity involving brokers and powerful shareholders in Indonesia. In this video, Firstpost examines how alleged wash trades and nominee accounts were used to create the appearance of strong demand, potentially helping companies qualify for MSCI indexes and attract global investment.
